payload.title: [anthus-site-content] give-an-agent-a-tool links to /solutions/sqlbot, which redirects (was 404)
payload.description:
**Problem**
The article give-an-agent-a-tool links to /solutions/sqlbot at lines 199 and 239; the audit saw 404. Today the URL answers 301 to the new location /articles/sqlbot/.

**Evidence**
give-an-agent-a-tool.mdx:199 and :239. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://anth.us/solutions/sqlbot` returns 301 (re-checked 2026-10-20); /articles/sqlbot/ returns 200.

**Fix**
Point both links directly at /articles/sqlbot/.

**How to verify**
`grep -n 'solutions/sqlbot' give-an-agent-a-tool.mdx` prints nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
